decisions.reason: The real diagonal model is well defined by the Hilbert/domain lemma. The existing self-adjointness lemma tests coordinate unit vectors to force the adjoint coefficients E_i y_i and exact domain equality, including empty I. Added that missing justified_by discharge and its imported Countable Choice qualification in Scope; the Definition is byte-for-byte unchanged.

Step 1.1 used an unrestricted conditional entropy sum, so zero conditional weights could evaluate log(0). Restricted precisely that proof sum to q(m|r)>0, matching the unchanged Statement. Positive joint entries factor as a_r q; their sums give the chain rule, zero marginals contribute nothing, and 0<q<=1 gives nonnegative entropy.

F4 named the exponential series definition where the partition factorization needs the addition law. Added the exact published addition theorem to deps, roles and F4. Finite Fubini now explicitly factors Z_N; coordinate independence gives variance Nv, the event-square estimate gives the probability bound, and positive-product logarithm laws give the unchanged free-energy identity. This is a nonfatal citation repair: the addition law also follows from the already declared logarithm inverse and product laws.

The mean-value supplier states an intermediate-derivative equality, whereas F5 compressed its consequences. Expanded F5 accurately and derived monotonicity of p_L prime, convexity and the secant sandwich by explicit MVT applications to smooth functions. Added exact calculus and exponential/logarithm algebra suppliers and chose one tilt satisfying both differentiability bounds. The variance identity, derivative squeeze and two exponential tails establish the unchanged claim; the omitted elementary MVT bridge is nonfatal.

F2 omitted the summable compact-interval majorant required by the cited differentiation theorem. Restated that exact hypothesis and checked it on J=(0,infinity): the two majorants are 1 and (1+epsilon^2)exp(-epsilon min K), with exponential monotonicity and positivity explicitly sourced. The canonical excited weight is positive, while the stipulated nonempty half-open shell is the ground singleton and assigns it zero; the Example is unchanged.

F3 attributed positivity to the series definition and derivative theorem; it now attributes positivity to the already declared logarithm inverse definition. Added the existing local monotone-convergence theorem for real integral linearity and exact derivative-algebra support. MVT bounds both measurable difference quotients by G_K; DCT along arbitrary increment sequences proves C2 and the moment identities. Normalization, variance expansion and the explicit absolute-entropy bound then prove the unchanged Statement on noncomplete measure spaces as well.
